title: Shipping Information
description: Information about shipping methods, delivery locations, shipping fees, and special handling requirements.
content:
# Shipping Information

PixelForge provides shipping services for gaming computers, computer components, peripherals, and accessories purchased through our online store. Our shipping procedures are designed to ensure that products arrive safely and that customers receive clear information about available delivery options and associated costs.

## Available Shipping Methods

Customers can choose between standard home delivery and delivery to a local pickup point, depending on the size, weight, and type of products ordered. Available shipping methods are displayed during checkout before the purchase is confirmed.

Standard home delivery is available for most products, including gaming PCs, monitors, and larger computer components. Smaller products, such as keyboards, mice, headsets, and storage devices, can generally be delivered to a pickup point.

Some oversized products may only be eligible for home delivery. If an order contains multiple products with different shipping requirements, PixelForge may combine them into one shipment or divide them into separate packages.

## Shipping Costs

Standard shipping within Sweden costs 69 SEK for orders with a total product value below 1,500 SEK. Orders with a product value of 1,500 SEK or more qualify for free standard shipping.

The free shipping threshold is calculated after discounts have been applied but before any shipping charges are added. Gift cards and other non-physical products do not count toward the threshold.

Certain oversized products may require special transportation. If an additional handling fee applies, the amount will be clearly displayed during checkout. Customers will never be charged an additional shipping fee after an order has been confirmed without their approval.

## Delivery Areas

PixelForge currently ships to addresses within Sweden. International shipping is not available, and orders cannot be delivered to addresses outside the country.

Deliveries to remote locations, islands, and areas with limited transportation services may take longer than deliveries to major cities. Some shipping methods may also be unavailable in these locations.

Customers must provide a complete and accurate delivery address, including their name, street address, postal code, city, and any necessary apartment or access information.

## Packaging and Product Protection

All products are packaged to reduce the risk of damage during transportation. Sensitive components, including graphics cards, motherboards, and storage devices, are shipped using protective materials appropriate for electronic equipment.

Prebuilt gaming PCs receive additional packaging to protect internal components and the computer case. Depending on the system configuration, protective materials may also be placed inside the computer during transportation. Customers should remove any internal transportation protection before turning on the computer, following the instructions included with the shipment.

## Multiple Shipments

An order containing several products may be divided into multiple shipments if the products are stored at different warehouse locations or require different handling methods.

When an order is divided, customers may receive separate tracking numbers for each package. There is no additional standard shipping charge for shipments divided by PixelForge after checkout.

## Delivery Responsibility

Customers should inspect the external packaging when receiving an order. If a package appears severely damaged, the customer should document the condition and contact PixelForge support as soon as possible.

For information about estimated delivery dates, see the Delivery Times article. For instructions on following an existing shipment, see Order Tracking.

title: Delivery Times
description: Estimated delivery times for in-stock products, gaming PCs, backorders, and special orders.
content:
# Delivery Times

Delivery times at PixelForge depend on product availability, order processing, warehouse operations, and the shipping method selected during checkout. We aim to provide realistic delivery estimates and communicate significant changes as early as possible.

All delivery estimates refer to business days unless otherwise stated. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding Swedish public holidays.

## Standard Delivery for In-Stock Products

Most in-stock products are delivered within 2–4 business days after they have been dispatched from our warehouse. This estimate applies to standard deliveries within Sweden and includes products such as graphics cards, processors, keyboards, mice, and other commonly stocked accessories.

The delivery estimate begins when the order has been dispatched, not when the purchase was placed. Customers receive a shipping confirmation when their package leaves the warehouse.

Delivery to remote locations or areas with limited transportation services may require additional time. Shipping providers may also experience temporary delays during periods of high demand.

## Order Processing

Orders are normally processed within one business day after payment has been confirmed. During processing, PixelForge verifies payment, checks product availability, and prepares the items for shipment.

Orders placed on weekends or Swedish public holidays are normally processed on the next business day. Orders placed late in the afternoon may also begin processing the following business day.

An order may require additional verification if the payment provider identifies an issue or if important delivery information is missing. PixelForge may contact the customer before continuing with the order.

## Prebuilt Gaming PCs

Prebuilt gaming PCs require additional preparation compared with individual components. Before shipping, each system undergoes a quality inspection that may include hardware checks, operating system verification, and basic stability testing.

The estimated total delivery time for a standard prebuilt gaming PC is normally 5–8 business days after payment confirmation. This includes preparation, testing, dispatch, and transportation.

Some configurations may require additional assembly or testing. If the estimated delivery time differs from the standard timeframe, this information should be displayed on the product page or communicated before shipment.

## Products That Are Temporarily Out of Stock

Products marked as temporarily unavailable cannot always be shipped immediately. If PixelForge accepts an order for an out-of-stock product, the customer will receive an estimated restocking date when that information is available.

Restocking dates are estimates provided by suppliers and may change. If a product cannot be delivered within the expected timeframe, PixelForge will inform the customer and explain the available options, including waiting for the product or requesting cancellation.

Customers are not required to accept an indefinite delay. An order that has not been dispatched can generally be cancelled by contacting customer support.

## Orders Containing Multiple Products

When an order includes both available and unavailable products, PixelForge may wait until all products are ready before shipping the order. In some cases, the available products may be shipped separately.

Customers will be informed if their order is divided into multiple shipments. Each shipment may have its own estimated delivery date and tracking number.

## Unexpected Delivery Delays

Delivery estimates may be affected by severe weather, transportation disruptions, warehouse problems, public holidays, or unusually high order volumes.

If PixelForge becomes aware of a significant delay, we will attempt to notify the customer by email. The notification should explain the reason for the delay when known and provide an updated estimate if possible.

## What to Do If Your Order Is Late

Customers should first check the tracking information included in their shipping confirmation. Tracking updates may occasionally be delayed even when a package is moving normally.

If the estimated delivery date has passed and no meaningful tracking update has appeared for several business days, customers should contact PixelForge support with their order number.

For shipping costs and delivery methods, see Shipping Information. For details about tracking updates and shipment statuses, see Order Tracking.

title: Order Tracking
description: How to follow an order, understand shipment statuses, and resolve tracking problems.
content:
# Order Tracking

PixelForge provides order tracking information so customers can follow their purchases from order confirmation to final delivery. Tracking information helps customers understand the current status of a shipment and identify when a package is expected to arrive.

Tracking becomes available after an order has been dispatched from the warehouse. Customers may also receive updates about earlier stages of the order through their confirmation emails.

## Receiving Your Tracking Information

Once an order has been shipped, PixelForge sends a shipping confirmation email to the address provided during checkout. This email normally includes the order number, shipping provider, tracking number, and a link to the provider's tracking service.

Customers should keep their order confirmation and shipping confirmation emails until the products have been delivered and inspected.

A shipping confirmation indicates that the package has been prepared for transportation or handed over to the shipping provider. It does not necessarily mean that the package will arrive on the same day.

## Understanding Order Statuses

PixelForge uses several statuses to describe the progress of an order.

- **Order Confirmed:** The purchase has been registered and an order confirmation has been sent.
- **Processing:** Payment and product availability are being verified, and the order is being prepared.
- **Preparing for Shipment:** The products are being packed and labelled for transportation.
- **Shipped:** The shipment has left the warehouse or has been handed over to the shipping provider.
- **In Transit:** The shipping provider is transporting the package toward its destination.
- **Out for Delivery:** The package is scheduled for delivery or transfer to a pickup point.
- **Delivered:** The shipping provider has registered the shipment as delivered.

These statuses describe the general delivery process. The shipping provider may use additional or slightly different status messages.

## When Tracking Information Becomes Available

Tracking information may take up to 24 hours to become visible after the shipping confirmation has been sent. This happens because shipping providers sometimes register packages in their systems after collecting them from the warehouse.

If a tracking link initially displays an error or reports that the shipment cannot be found, customers should wait and try again later.

If the tracking information remains unavailable more than 24 hours after shipping confirmation, customers can contact PixelForge support for assistance.

## Tracking Multiple Packages

Orders containing several products may be shipped in more than one package. This is especially common when an order includes a large gaming PC together with smaller accessories or components.

Each package may receive a separate tracking number. Customers should check all tracking numbers before reporting missing items, since different packages may arrive on different days.

PixelForge does not charge additional standard shipping fees when an order is divided into multiple shipments by our warehouse.

## Tracking a Delivery to a Pickup Point

When a shipment is delivered to a pickup point, the shipping provider normally sends a notification explaining where and when the package can be collected.

Customers may need to present valid identification or follow the shipping provider's digital identification procedure. Collection deadlines are determined by the shipping provider and are normally stated in the notification.

If a package is not collected within the specified period, it may be returned to the sender. Customers should contact PixelForge support if this happens.

## Missing or Incorrect Tracking Updates

Tracking systems do not always update in real time. A package may remain on the same status for one or two business days while it is being transported between distribution facilities.

If tracking has not changed for more than three business days, or if the estimated delivery date has passed without further information, customers should contact support with their order number and tracking number.

PixelForge can investigate the shipment with the transportation provider when necessary.

## Package Marked as Delivered but Not Received

If a shipment is marked as delivered but cannot be located, customers should first check the delivery location, mailbox, pickup point notification, and any instructions provided by the shipping company.

Customers should then contact PixelForge support promptly. The support team may request confirmation of the delivery address and investigate the shipment with the shipping provider.

For estimated transportation times, see Delivery Times. For information about delivery methods and packaging, see Shipping Information.

title: Cancelling an Order
description: Learn when an order can be cancelled, how to request cancellation, and what happens to your payment.
content:
# Cancelling an Order

Customers may sometimes need to cancel a purchase because they ordered the wrong product, entered incorrect information, or changed their plans. PixelForge aims to handle cancellation requests as quickly as possible while explaining any limitations that apply once an order has entered the shipping process.

The possibility of cancelling an order depends primarily on its current processing and shipping status.

## Cancelling Before Dispatch

An order that has not yet been dispatched can generally be cancelled by contacting PixelForge customer support. Customers should submit their cancellation request as soon as possible to increase the likelihood that the warehouse can stop the shipment.

To request cancellation, customers should provide their order number, the email address used during checkout, and a short explanation of which products they wish to cancel.

PixelForge will review the order status and confirm whether cancellation is possible. Sending a cancellation request does not automatically mean that the order has been cancelled.

## Orders That Are Being Prepared

Orders with the status Processing or Preparing for Shipment may already be undergoing warehouse handling. In these situations, PixelForge will attempt to stop the order before dispatch, but cancellation cannot always be guaranteed.

Some orders are packed and handed over to shipping providers shortly after processing begins. If the shipment cannot be stopped, the customer may need to follow the return procedure after delivery.

Customers should avoid placing duplicate cancellation requests, since multiple messages may make it more difficult for support staff to follow the case efficiently.

## Cancelling an Order After Dispatch

Once an order has been dispatched, it can normally no longer be cancelled through the standard order cancellation process.

Customers who no longer want the products should instead follow the applicable return procedure after receiving the shipment. The Return Policy explains the conditions and steps involved in returning purchased products.

Customers should not assume that refusing a delivery or leaving a package uncollected is equivalent to an approved cancellation. Uncollected shipments may require additional handling and should be discussed with support.

## Partial Order Cancellation

Customers may request cancellation of individual products within an order while keeping the remaining items. Partial cancellation is possible when the affected products have not yet been dispatched and the warehouse can adjust the order.

If the cancellation reduces the remaining order value below the free shipping threshold of 1,500 SEK, the final shipping cost may need to be recalculated. Any resulting changes will be explained before the adjustment is confirmed.

If a product has already been shipped separately, it must normally be handled through the return process instead.

## Cancelling Prebuilt Gaming PCs

Prebuilt gaming PCs may require assembly, configuration, and testing before dispatch. Customers should therefore contact support immediately if they wish to cancel an order for a gaming PC.

Standard prebuilt configurations can generally be considered for cancellation before dispatch. Orders involving specially requested configurations may require additional review, particularly if assembly or customization has already started.

The applicable cancellation and withdrawal rights depend on the nature of the purchase and relevant consumer protection rules. PixelForge will explain the available options for the specific order.

## Refunds Following Cancellation

When an order is successfully cancelled, PixelForge initiates a refund using the original payment method whenever possible.

Refund processing normally begins within two business days after cancellation has been confirmed. The time required for the money to appear in the customer's account depends on the payment provider and may take an additional 3–5 business days.

For orders paid through an invoice or instalment provider, the payment provider may need to adjust or cancel the outstanding payment separately.

Customers should keep the cancellation confirmation until the refund has been completed.

## Changing an Order Instead of Cancelling

If a customer only needs to correct an address or change a product, cancellation may not always be necessary. Support may be able to update the order before dispatch.

Changes to products, quantities, or delivery addresses cannot be guaranteed once warehouse processing has started. Customers should contact support rather than placing a replacement order immediately, unless instructed otherwise.

## Contacting Customer Support

Cancellation requests should include the order number and enough information to identify the purchase. PixelForge will confirm whether the request has been approved and provide further instructions if the order cannot be stopped.

For information about when products are normally dispatched, see Delivery Times. For orders already in transportation, see Order Tracking. For products that have already been delivered, consult the Return Policy.

title: Return Policy
description: Learn about return eligibility, withdrawal rights, return shipping, and how to send products back to PixelForge.
content:
# Return Policy

PixelForge wants customers to feel confident when purchasing gaming hardware, computer components, and accessories online. This return policy explains how customers can return products, which conditions apply, and what happens after a return has been requested.

The policy applies to purchases made through the PixelForge online store by customers in Sweden. It does not limit any mandatory rights provided by Swedish consumer protection legislation.

## Right of Withdrawal

Consumers purchasing products online generally have a statutory right to withdraw from their purchase within 14 days after receiving the goods. For orders delivered in multiple shipments, the withdrawal period normally begins when the final item has been received.

PixelForge also offers a voluntary 30-day return period for standard products. This additional return period allows customers to request a return within 30 calendar days of receiving their order, provided the conditions described below are satisfied.

The voluntary return policy does not replace or reduce the customer's statutory withdrawal rights. Different conditions may apply to certain specially manufactured or personalized products where an applicable legal exception exists.

## Conditions for Returning Products

Products returned under PixelForge's voluntary 30-day return policy should be complete, reasonably clean, and free from damage caused by improper handling. Customers should include all original accessories, cables, manuals, and other items supplied with the product.

Original packaging should be retained whenever possible, particularly for sensitive electronic components. However, the absence of original packaging does not automatically remove a customer's statutory right of withdrawal.

Customers are permitted to inspect and test products to the extent necessary to establish their nature, characteristics, and functionality. Handling beyond what is necessary may result in a deduction for diminished value where permitted by law.

## Products With Special Return Conditions

Certain products require additional consideration. Specially manufactured or clearly personalized products may be excluded from withdrawal rights when the relevant legal conditions are met.

Prebuilt gaming PCs sold in standard configurations are generally covered by the ordinary withdrawal rules. A computer does not automatically become exempt simply because PixelForge assembled it before delivery.

Products containing customer data, such as SSDs, hard drives, and computers, should be backed up and securely erased before being returned. PixelForge cannot guarantee the preservation of files stored on returned equipment.

## How to Request a Return

Customers should contact PixelForge customer support and provide their order number, the products they wish to return, and the reason for the request if they choose to share it.

A customer exercising a statutory withdrawal right does not need to provide a reason. The withdrawal request must be communicated within the applicable withdrawal period.

Support will provide return instructions, including the appropriate return address and any available shipping label. Customers should package products carefully and retain proof of shipment.

After notifying PixelForge of withdrawal, customers normally have 14 days to send the goods back.

## Return Shipping Costs

For ordinary returns under the right of withdrawal or the voluntary return policy, customers are generally responsible for direct return shipping costs when this has been communicated before purchase.

PixelForge covers reasonable return shipping costs for verified faulty products, incorrect items, and products damaged during delivery when the return is handled as an accepted complaint.

Customers should contact support before returning unusually large or heavy products, including gaming PCs and monitors, so that suitable transportation can be arranged.

## Inspection of Returned Products

Returned products are inspected after arriving at the PixelForge warehouse. The inspection checks that the correct product has been received and evaluates its condition, accessories, and any reported defects.

The inspection normally begins within three business days after the return has been registered as received. More complicated technical assessments may require additional time.

A return inspection does not remove the customer's statutory rights. Any proposed deduction or rejection must be supported by the circumstances of the specific return.

## Refunds and Processing Times

For statutory withdrawals, refunds are handled according to applicable legal deadlines. PixelForge may generally withhold reimbursement until the goods have been received or the customer has provided evidence that they have been sent back, whichever occurs first.

For approved returns under the voluntary 30-day policy, PixelForge normally initiates the refund within five business days after the return inspection has been completed.

Refunds are generally issued through the original payment method. The payment provider may require an additional 3–5 business days to make the funds visible in the customer's account.

For more detailed information about refund methods and payment processing, see Refund Process. For damaged or defective deliveries, consult Damaged Products.

title: Refund Process
description: Information about refund approval, payment methods, processing times, partial refunds, and refund delays.
content:
# Refund Process

This document explains how PixelForge processes refunds following approved returns, order cancellations, incorrect charges, and other situations where money must be returned to a customer.

The refund procedure depends on the reason for reimbursement, the original payment method, and whether the customer has already received the products.

## When a Refund May Be Issued

PixelForge may issue a refund when an order is successfully cancelled before dispatch, when a customer exercises their right of withdrawal, when a return under the voluntary return policy is approved, or when a complaint is resolved through reimbursement.

Refunds may also be necessary if a product becomes permanently unavailable, an order has been charged incorrectly, or an item cannot be replaced within an acceptable timeframe.

Customers will receive confirmation when a refund has been approved or initiated. This confirmation normally identifies the affected order and the amount being reimbursed.

## Refunds for Cancelled Orders

When an order is cancelled before dispatch, PixelForge normally begins refund processing within two business days after the cancellation has been confirmed.

The customer does not need to return any products if the order was successfully stopped before shipment.

If an order has already been dispatched, it generally cannot be cancelled through the ordinary cancellation procedure. The customer may instead need to exercise their withdrawal rights or request a return after delivery.

For more information, see Cancelling an Order.

## Refunds for Returned Products

For returns under the statutory right of withdrawal, PixelForge follows the reimbursement deadlines required by Swedish consumer law. Reimbursement must generally be made without undue delay and no later than 14 days after the customer communicated the withdrawal, although PixelForge may withhold payment until the goods have been received or evidence of their return has been provided.

For returns accepted under PixelForge's voluntary 30-day policy, refund processing normally begins within five business days after the warehouse inspection has been completed.

Products returned because of a defect or an incorrect delivery may require a separate complaint assessment. The customer will be informed about the outcome and the available remedies.

## Original Payment Methods

Refunds are normally sent to the same payment method used for the original purchase.

For card payments, the amount is returned to the original payment card. For purchases made through an invoice or instalment provider, the provider may adjust the invoice, cancel an outstanding payment, or reimburse amounts already paid.

If the original payment method is no longer available, the customer should contact support. PixelForge may request additional verification before arranging an alternative reimbursement method.

## How Long Does a Refund Take?

Once PixelForge has initiated a refund, banks and payment providers commonly require an additional 3–5 business days to process the transaction. Actual processing times may vary between providers.

This payment processing period is separate from the time required to approve a return or cancellation.

For example, a cancellation approved on Monday may be submitted for reimbursement by Wednesday, while the funds may not appear on the customer's payment account until several business days later.

These estimates describe normal administrative processing and do not override statutory refund deadlines.

## Shipping Charges and Partial Refunds

When a consumer withdraws from an entire online purchase, the refund generally includes the original standard delivery charge. Additional costs resulting from the customer choosing a more expensive delivery method than the least expensive standard option do not normally have to be reimbursed.

If only part of an order is returned, the shipping refund depends on the circumstances of the purchase and applicable consumer rights.

For voluntary returns, PixelForge may make deductions for diminished product value or other conditions permitted under the voluntary policy. Any deduction will be explained to the customer.

Customers returning defective or incorrectly supplied products should not be charged reasonable return transportation costs for an accepted complaint.

## Refunds for Multiple Products

If an order contains several products and only one is returned, PixelForge normally refunds the value of that product rather than the entire order.

Discounts applied to bundles or multi-product promotions may affect the amount refunded when only part of the original purchase is returned. The calculation will be explained before the refund is finalized.

If products were delivered in separate shipments, refunds may be processed separately as the relevant returns are completed.

## Missing or Delayed Refunds

Customers who have received a refund confirmation but cannot see the payment should first check the original payment method and allow for the processing time communicated by their payment provider.

If more than five business days have passed since the refund was initiated and the funds are still missing, the customer should contact PixelForge support with their order number and refund confirmation.

Support can investigate the transaction and provide additional information about its status.

## Refund Confirmation and Documentation

Customers should retain refund confirmation emails until the reimbursement has been completed. These messages may be useful when contacting a bank or payment provider.

For return eligibility and instructions, see Return Policy. For cancellations before dispatch, see Cancelling an Order.

title: Damaged Products
description: What to do when products arrive damaged, are defective, or are missing items from a delivery.
content:
# Damaged Products

PixelForge takes product quality and safe transportation seriously. Despite careful packaging and handling, products can occasionally arrive damaged, defective, or incomplete.

This document explains how customers should report these situations and what information helps PixelForge investigate and resolve the problem efficiently.

## Inspecting a Delivery

Customers are encouraged to inspect the external packaging when receiving a shipment. Visible damage may include crushed corners, punctures, torn packaging, water exposure, or signs that a package has been opened during transportation.

If significant damage is visible, customers should photograph the package before opening it when reasonably possible. The photographs may help identify whether damage occurred during transportation.

Customers should also inspect the products and included accessories after opening the package. Packaging materials should be retained until any potential delivery problem has been resolved.

## Reporting Transportation Damage

Customers should contact PixelForge support as soon as possible after discovering transportation damage. Reporting the issue promptly makes it easier to investigate the shipment with the transportation provider.

PixelForge recommends reporting visible transportation damage within 48 hours of delivery when practical. This is a recommended reporting timeframe, not a limitation of the customer's statutory complaint rights.

The customer should provide their order number, a description of the damage, and photographs of the affected product and packaging if available.

Customers should not attempt to repair a visibly damaged product before receiving guidance from support, particularly when the product contains electrical components.

## Products That Do Not Work Correctly

A product may appear undamaged externally but fail to function correctly when installed or used.

Examples include a graphics card that produces no display output, a monitor with display defects, a keyboard with non-functioning keys, or a gaming PC that fails to start.

Customers should first follow any safe and reasonable troubleshooting instructions included with the product. If the issue remains, they should contact PixelForge support and describe the symptoms.

For complex products, support may request additional information such as the product model, serial number, error messages, or a description of the computer configuration.

Customers should not open power supplies or attempt other potentially dangerous repairs.

## Missing Products or Accessories

If a delivery appears incomplete, customers should first check whether the order was divided into multiple shipments. Orders containing gaming PCs and smaller accessories may arrive in separate packages with different tracking numbers.

The shipping confirmation email normally identifies the dispatched products and provides tracking information for the shipment.

If an item is missing and no additional shipment is expected, customers should contact PixelForge support with their order number and details of the missing product.

Missing cables, adapters, manuals, or other included accessories should also be reported so that PixelForge can determine the appropriate solution.

## Incorrect Products

If a customer receives a different product from the one ordered, they should contact support before returning or installing the item.

The customer should provide the order number, the product received, and the product originally purchased. Photographs of product labels may help verify the mistake.

When PixelForge confirms that an incorrect item was supplied, we will arrange an appropriate correction without charging the customer for reasonable return shipping.

## How PixelForge Handles Complaints

When a complaint is received, PixelForge reviews the order details and the information provided by the customer. Depending on the circumstances, support may recommend troubleshooting, arrange a return for inspection, offer a replacement, or propose another remedy.

Under Swedish consumer protection rules, customers may have rights to repair, replacement, price reduction, or cancellation of the purchase depending on the nature of the defect and the applicable legal conditions.

PixelForge does not automatically require customers to accept a refund instead of another remedy where consumer law provides otherwise.

## Returning a Damaged or Defective Product

If a return is necessary, support will provide packaging and shipping instructions. Customers should use appropriate protective materials to prevent additional damage during transportation.

For accepted complaints involving defective, damaged, or incorrectly delivered products, PixelForge covers reasonable return shipping costs.

Large or heavy items, including gaming PCs and monitors, may require a specially arranged collection or transportation service.

Customers should back up personal files and remove sensitive information from computers and storage devices before returning them whenever reasonably possible.

## Replacement Products and Refunds

If a replacement is approved, PixelForge will provide information about availability and the expected dispatch date. Replacement delivery times may depend on current stock levels.

If reimbursement is the appropriate remedy, the refund is normally processed through the original payment method. The time required for the payment to appear depends on the payment provider.

Customers should retain their complaint reference and any related correspondence until the case has been resolved.

## Customer Rights and Further Assistance

A recommendation to report transportation damage within 48 hours does not remove statutory rights. Under Swedish consumer law, consumers generally have a three-year right to complain about defects in goods, subject to the applicable requirements.

For instructions about ordinary returns, see Return Policy. For reimbursement procedures, see Refund Process. For problems involving tracking or missing shipments, see Order Tracking.

title: Warranty Policy
description: Information about product warranties, consumer complaint rights, warranty claims, and hardware repairs.
content:
# Warranty Policy

PixelForge sells gaming computers, computer components, and accessories from established manufacturers. This warranty policy explains the difference between manufacturer warranties, additional warranties offered by PixelForge, and the statutory rights customers have when purchasing products in Sweden.

Warranty coverage may vary depending on the product, manufacturer, and conditions stated at the time of purchase. Customers should retain their purchase confirmation and any documentation supplied with the product.

## Manufacturer Warranties

Many products sold by PixelForge include a manufacturer's commercial warranty. This may cover manufacturing defects, component failures, or other problems described in the manufacturer's warranty conditions.

The warranty period differs between products. For example, certain computer components may include a three-year manufacturer warranty, while some accessories may have shorter or longer coverage.

The exact warranty period and applicable conditions are determined by the manufacturer and should be stated in the product documentation or warranty information supplied with the purchase.

A manufacturer's warranty does not replace the customer's statutory rights against PixelForge as the seller.

## PixelForge Prebuilt Gaming PCs

Standard prebuilt gaming PCs assembled and sold by PixelForge include a voluntary two-year PixelForge hardware warranty, unless a different warranty period is clearly stated at purchase.

This warranty covers manufacturing and assembly defects affecting the computer's supplied hardware under normal operating conditions. Examples may include faulty internal components, defective connections, or assembly-related problems.

The warranty applies to the original configuration supplied by PixelForge. Customers may upgrade or replace compatible components, but damage caused by incorrect installation or modification is not covered by the voluntary warranty.

Opening a computer case does not automatically invalidate statutory consumer rights. Any warranty exclusion must be assessed in relation to the actual cause of the problem.

## What Is Not Normally Covered?

Commercial warranties generally do not cover accidental damage, liquid exposure, damage caused by improper electrical connections, or faults resulting from misuse.

Normal cosmetic wear, damage caused by unauthorized or unsuitable modifications, and problems caused by incompatible third-party components may also fall outside voluntary warranty coverage.

Software problems caused by malware, unsupported modifications, or user-installed applications are not normally treated as hardware manufacturing defects.

These exclusions describe commercial warranty conditions and do not automatically determine whether a customer has a valid statutory complaint.

## Statutory Consumer Rights in Sweden

Consumers purchasing goods from a business in Sweden generally have the right to complain about defects for three years after receiving the goods under the Swedish Consumer Sales Act.

A complaint must be made within a reasonable time after the defect was discovered or should have been discovered. Complaints made within two months of discovering a defect are considered to have been made within a reasonable time.

For defects that become apparent within two years of delivery, the seller generally has the burden of showing that the defect was not present at delivery, subject to applicable legal exceptions.

Statutory complaint rights apply independently of any commercial warranty and cannot be removed by shorter warranty conditions.

## How to Submit a Warranty Claim

Customers should contact PixelForge support with their order number, product name, and a description of the problem.

Support may request the product's serial number, photographs, error messages, or details about when the fault occurs. Customers may also be asked to perform safe troubleshooting steps before returning the product.

If an inspection is required, PixelForge will provide instructions for returning the affected product. Customers should not attempt dangerous repairs or open sealed electrical components such as power supplies.

## Repairs, Replacements, and Refunds

Depending on the nature of the defect and applicable consumer rights, PixelForge may arrange a repair, replacement, price reduction, or refund.

Repairs and replacements for accepted statutory complaints must be handled according to applicable consumer law, including requirements concerning cost, reasonable time, and inconvenience to the customer.

A replacement product may have a different delivery estimate depending on current stock availability.

## Data Protection During Repairs

Customers should back up important files before sending computers or storage devices for inspection or repair. Technical troubleshooting may require reinstalling software, replacing storage hardware, or resetting the device.

Customers should remove sensitive personal information whenever reasonably possible and should not include passwords or account credentials unless a specific secure procedure has been agreed upon.

For information about defective deliveries, see Damaged Products. For reimbursement procedures, see Refund Process. For details about personal information, consult Personal Data & GDPR.

title: Personal Data & GDPR
description: How PixelForge collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information under GDPR.
content:
# Personal Data & GDPR

PixelForge processes personal information when customers create accounts, purchase products, contact support, or use services provided through our website. This document explains the main categories of personal data we process, why the information is needed, and which rights individuals have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

PixelForge AB is the data controller for personal data processed for the purposes described in this document, unless otherwise stated for a specific service.

## What Personal Information Do We Collect?

When customers place an order, PixelForge may collect their name, email address, telephone number, billing address, delivery address, and information about the products purchased.

Customers who create an account may also provide login credentials and account preferences. Passwords should be stored using appropriate cryptographic hashing rather than in readable form.

When customers contact support, we may process correspondence, order references, product information, and other details necessary to resolve the request.

Technical information such as IP addresses, browser characteristics, and security logs may also be processed when necessary to operate and protect the website.

PixelForge does not require customers to provide more personal information than is reasonably necessary for the relevant service.

## Why Do We Process Personal Data?

PixelForge processes personal data for several purposes, including completing purchases, delivering orders, providing customer support, handling returns, and fulfilling legal obligations.

Order and delivery information is generally processed because it is necessary to perform a contract with the customer.

Certain financial records must be retained to comply with accounting and tax obligations. Processing necessary for those purposes is based on legal obligations.

Security monitoring and prevention of fraudulent activity may rely on legitimate interests, provided the relevant requirements and balancing assessments are satisfied.

Marketing communications that require consent are only sent when an appropriate legal basis has been established. Customers can withdraw marketing consent at any time.

## Payment Information

Payments may be processed through external payment service providers. PixelForge receives the transaction information needed to confirm and administer purchases but does not normally store complete payment card details in its own application database.

Payment providers may process additional information under their own privacy notices and legal responsibilities.

## Sharing Information With Other Companies

PixelForge may share necessary personal information with delivery providers, payment processors, hosting providers, and other service partners involved in operating the business.

For example, a shipping provider may receive the customer's name, delivery address, and contact details to complete a delivery.

Service providers acting as data processors must process information according to appropriate agreements and instructions. Personal information is not sold to advertisers.

## How Long Is Personal Data Stored?

PixelForge retains personal information only for as long as necessary for the relevant purpose or as required by law.

Accounting information may need to be retained for seven years under Swedish bookkeeping requirements. Certain order records may therefore remain stored even after a customer account has been deleted.

Support correspondence and account information are reviewed according to their operational purpose and applicable retention rules. Data that is no longer required should be deleted or anonymized securely.

Retention periods may differ depending on the type of information and the legal basis for processing.

## Your Rights Under GDPR

Individuals have several rights under GDPR, subject to applicable conditions and exceptions.

- **Right of access:** Request information about personal data being processed and obtain a copy where applicable.
- **Right to rectification:** Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information.
- **Right to erasure:** Request deletion of personal information when the legal requirements are satisfied.
- **Right to restriction:** Request that certain processing activities be restricted in qualifying circumstances.
- **Right to data portability:** Receive certain personal information in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format.
- **Right to object:** Object to processing based on legitimate interests or to direct marketing.
- **Right to withdraw consent:** Withdraw consent for processing that relies on consent.

These rights are not absolute. For example, PixelForge may be required to retain transaction records even when a customer requests deletion of their account.

## Requesting Access or Deletion

Customers can contact PixelForge support to submit a personal data request. The request should clearly describe the action being requested.

PixelForge may need to verify the requester's identity before disclosing, changing, or deleting personal information. Identity verification should be proportionate and avoid unnecessary collection of additional data.

GDPR requests must generally be answered within one month. In certain circumstances, this period may be extended by up to two additional months, with the individual informed of the extension and reasons within the initial month.

Individuals may also lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection, Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten (IMY).

## International Data Transfers

If personal information is transferred outside the European Economic Area, PixelForge must ensure that an appropriate transfer mechanism and required safeguards are in place.

The applicable safeguards depend on the destination, service provider, and circumstances of the transfer.

## Protecting Personal Information

PixelForge uses technical and organizational measures intended to protect personal information against unauthorized access, accidental loss, and improper disclosure.

These measures may include encrypted connections, access controls, secure authentication, backups, and security monitoring.

For information about account settings and account deletion, see Customer Accounts. For browser cookies and tracking technologies, consult Cookies & Privacy.

title: Cookies & Privacy
description: Information about website cookies, analytics, consent preferences, and browser privacy settings.
content:
# Cookies & Privacy

The PixelForge website may use cookies and similar technologies to provide essential functionality, remember user preferences, improve website performance, and understand how visitors interact with the store.

A cookie is a small piece of information stored on a user's device by a website. Cookies can be used to maintain a shopping cart, keep a user signed in, or remember selected settings between visits.

This document explains the categories of cookies used by PixelForge and how visitors can manage their preferences.

## Strictly Necessary Cookies

Strictly necessary cookies support essential website functions and services explicitly requested by the user.

Examples include maintaining shopping cart contents, managing authentication sessions, remembering security-related settings, and supporting checkout operations.

These cookies may be used without consent when they are strictly necessary for the requested service, but visitors must still receive appropriate information about their use.

Disabling essential cookies through browser settings may prevent certain website features from functioning correctly.

## Analytics Cookies

Analytics cookies may help PixelForge understand how visitors use the website. For example, analytics can provide information about frequently visited pages, navigation patterns, and technical errors.

PixelForge uses analytics information to evaluate website performance and identify areas that may need improvement.

Analytics cookies that are not strictly necessary require appropriate consent before being placed or accessed. Visitors who decline analytics cookies should still be able to browse and purchase products through the website.

## Marketing Cookies

Marketing cookies may be used to measure advertising effectiveness or support relevant promotional campaigns.

These cookies may involve third-party advertising services and can potentially track activity across multiple websites.

PixelForge only activates non-essential marketing cookies when the visitor has provided valid consent. Declining marketing cookies does not prevent access to ordinary store functionality.

## Cookie Consent and Preferences

When visitors first access the PixelForge website, they may be presented with a cookie consent interface explaining the available categories.

Visitors should be able to accept or reject non-essential cookies and make meaningful choices about optional tracking.

Consent must be freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous where required. Visitors must also be able to withdraw consent as easily as they gave it.

PixelForge should provide a way to reopen cookie preferences and update previous choices without requiring customers to contact support.

## Session Cookies and Persistent Cookies

Session cookies are generally removed when the browsing session ends. They are commonly used for temporary functions such as maintaining a login session or shopping cart state.

Persistent cookies remain on the device for a defined period or until they are removed. They may be used to remember preferences or consent decisions between visits.

The duration of each cookie depends on its purpose and configuration. Cookies should not be retained longer than necessary for their intended function.

## Managing Cookies in Your Browser

Most modern browsers allow users to view, block, or delete stored cookies through privacy and security settings.

Customers can also use private browsing modes or browser features designed to limit cross-site tracking.

Deleting cookies may sign users out of their accounts, remove remembered preferences, or clear temporary shopping cart information.

Browser controls do not replace the website's responsibility to obtain valid consent for non-essential cookies.

## Third-Party Services

Some PixelForge services may rely on external providers for payment processing, website analytics, or embedded functionality.

These providers may use cookies or similar technologies according to their specific role and applicable privacy requirements.

PixelForge must ensure that appropriate information is provided about third-party technologies and that consent requirements are respected.

## Cookies and Personal Data

Certain cookies and online identifiers may constitute personal data when they can identify or be linked to an individual.

Where personal data is processed, GDPR requirements apply in addition to the rules governing access to information stored on users' devices.

For information about personal data processing, retention, and individual rights, see Personal Data & GDPR. For account-related preferences and security, see Customer Accounts.

title: Customer Accounts
description: How to create and manage a PixelForge account, update personal details, protect your login, and request account deletion.
content:
# Customer Accounts

A PixelForge customer account provides a convenient way to manage purchases, review order information, and maintain personal preferences. Customers can use an account to access features that would otherwise require entering the same information repeatedly.

Creating an account is optional for ordinary purchases when guest checkout is available. Customers should only provide information necessary for the services they choose to use.

## Creating a Customer Account

Customers can register an account by providing a valid email address, choosing a password, and completing any required verification steps.

The email address is used for account identification, important service notifications, and account recovery.

Customers should choose a strong, unique password that is not reused across other websites. Password managers can help generate and store secure passwords.

PixelForge may require email verification before enabling certain account features or accepting changes to sensitive information.

## Signing In and Account Security

Customers should keep their login credentials confidential and avoid sharing passwords with other people.

PixelForge uses security measures intended to protect account information, including encrypted connections and appropriate password storage practices.

Repeated unsuccessful login attempts may trigger temporary security restrictions to reduce the risk of unauthorized access.

Customers using shared or public computers should sign out after completing their session and avoid saving passwords in browsers they do not control.

## Resetting a Forgotten Password

Customers who forget their password can request a password reset through the login page.

A reset link or verification procedure is sent to the email address associated with the account. Password reset links should be time-limited and should not reveal the customer's existing password.

If the reset email does not arrive, customers should check their spam folder and verify that they entered the correct email address.

Customers who no longer have access to their registered email address should contact support. Additional identity verification may be necessary before account recovery can proceed.

## Updating Personal Information

Signed-in customers may update certain account details, such as their name, telephone number, and saved delivery address.

Changes to saved account information do not necessarily update orders that have already been placed. Customers who need to change the delivery address for an active order should contact support as soon as possible.

Once an order has entered warehouse processing or shipping, changes to delivery information may no longer be possible.

## Viewing Previous Orders

Customer accounts may display previous purchases, order numbers, payment status, and shipment information.

Orders placed using guest checkout may not automatically appear in an account created later, even when the same email address was used.

Customers should retain order confirmation emails because they may be needed for returns, warranty claims, or support requests.

For details about delivery statuses and tracking numbers, see Order Tracking.

## Managing Communication Preferences

Customers may be able to choose whether they receive optional marketing communications from PixelForge.

Marketing preferences are separate from essential service notifications. Customers may continue to receive necessary messages about orders, payments, security, or account changes even when marketing messages have been disabled.

Where marketing processing relies on consent, customers can withdraw that consent at any time.

## Requesting Account Deletion

Customers can request deletion of their PixelForge account by contacting support. PixelForge may require identity verification before completing the request.

Account deletion generally removes access to the account and information that is no longer required for another lawful purpose.

However, certain transaction records may need to be retained to comply with accounting, tax, consumer protection, or other legal obligations.

For example, accounting information may need to be stored for seven years under Swedish bookkeeping requirements even if the associated customer account has been closed.

Deleting an account does not automatically cancel active orders, eliminate outstanding payment obligations, or terminate an ongoing warranty claim.

## Unauthorized Account Activity

Customers who suspect that someone has accessed their account without permission should change their password immediately if they can still sign in.

They should also review recent orders and account details for unexpected changes and contact PixelForge support if suspicious activity is identified.

PixelForge may temporarily restrict account access while investigating a potential security incident.

## Personal Data and Privacy Rights

Customers have rights regarding their personal information under GDPR, including rights of access, correction, and erasure in qualifying circumstances.

Account deletion and GDPR erasure requests are related but not identical. Some information may remain stored because PixelForge has a separate legal obligation or another valid basis for retaining it.

For more information about personal data processing and individual rights, see Personal Data & GDPR. For information about cookies and website tracking, consult Cookies & Privacy.

title: PC Components Compatibility
description: Learn how to check compatibility between processors, motherboards, graphics cards, memory, power supplies, and PC cases.
content:
# PC Components Compatibility

Building or upgrading a gaming PC requires careful consideration of hardware compatibility. Computer components may use different physical connectors, electrical standards, and technical specifications. Even when two products are individually functional, they may not work together in the same computer.

PixelForge recommends checking compatibility before purchasing components, particularly when upgrading an existing system or assembling a computer from individual parts.

## Processor and Motherboard Compatibility

The processor and motherboard must use compatible CPU sockets. For example, AMD Ryzen processors designed for the AM5 socket require a compatible AM5 motherboard, while Intel processors designed for the LGA1700 socket require a motherboard supporting that socket.

A matching socket does not always guarantee compatibility. Motherboards also require appropriate chipset support and a BIOS version that recognizes the processor.

Customers should consult the motherboard manufacturer's CPU compatibility list before purchasing a processor. This list normally identifies supported processor models and any minimum BIOS requirements.

Installing an incompatible processor can prevent the computer from starting. Customers should never force a processor into a socket or attempt to modify physical connectors.

## Memory Compatibility

Modern desktop computers commonly use DDR4 or DDR5 memory. These standards are not interchangeable, and a motherboard designed for DDR4 cannot use DDR5 modules unless it has specifically designed compatible slots, which ordinary consumer motherboards do not provide.

Memory compatibility also depends on supported capacities, speeds, module configurations, and motherboard firmware.

A memory kit advertised at a particular speed may require enabling an XMP or EXPO profile in the BIOS. The maximum stable speed depends on the processor, motherboard, and memory configuration.

PixelForge recommends purchasing matched memory kits rather than combining modules with different specifications. Mixing memory may work in some systems but can cause reduced performance or stability problems.

## Graphics Card Compatibility

Most modern dedicated graphics cards use a PCI Express x16 expansion slot. PCI Express generations are generally designed with backward compatibility, although available bandwidth may differ depending on the motherboard and graphics card.

Physical dimensions are an important consideration. High-performance graphics cards may occupy several expansion slots and require significant clearance inside the computer case.

Customers should compare the graphics card's length, thickness, and height with the maximum dimensions supported by the case. Additional space may be required for power connectors and cable routing.

A graphics card may also require one or more dedicated power connectors. Customers must verify that their power supply provides the correct connectors and sufficient capacity.

## Power Supply Requirements

The power supply must provide enough electrical power for the complete system, including the processor, graphics card, storage devices, cooling equipment, and connected accessories.

A power supply's advertised wattage should not be the only factor considered. Build quality, efficiency, connector availability, and manufacturer recommendations are also important.

For example, a gaming PC with a high-performance graphics card may require a substantially larger power supply than a system using integrated graphics.

Customers should follow the graphics card manufacturer's recommended system power requirements and allow reasonable capacity for other components and future upgrades.

Modular power supply cables are not necessarily interchangeable between different brands or models. Using an incompatible modular cable can damage connected hardware.

## Storage Compatibility

Modern motherboards may support SATA storage devices and M.2 solid-state drives. However, not all M.2 slots support the same interfaces.

An M.2 drive may use SATA or PCI Express NVMe technology, and customers must verify that the motherboard slot supports the intended drive type.

NVMe drives are available in different PCI Express generations and physical lengths. A motherboard may support a newer drive at a lower speed, depending on its capabilities.

Some motherboards share bandwidth between storage connectors and expansion slots. Installing a particular M.2 drive may disable another connector or reduce available PCI Express lanes.

Customers should consult the motherboard manual for these limitations.

## Cooling and Case Compatibility

CPU coolers must support the processor socket and fit within the computer case. Large air coolers may interfere with tall memory modules or exceed the case's maximum supported cooler height.

Liquid cooling radiators require suitable mounting locations and sufficient clearance for fans, tubing, and nearby components.

Case airflow should also be considered. High-performance hardware produces heat that must be removed efficiently to maintain stable operation.

## BIOS Updates and Firmware

Some compatible components require a BIOS update before they can function correctly. This is particularly relevant when installing a newer processor on an older motherboard.

BIOS updates should be performed according to the motherboard manufacturer's instructions. Interrupting a firmware update may prevent the motherboard from starting.

Customers who are uncertain about compatibility should contact PixelForge support before purchasing or installing components.

## Compatibility Assistance

PixelForge can provide general guidance about component specifications and common compatibility requirements. Customers should provide the exact model numbers of their existing components when requesting assistance.

For information about complete computer configurations, see Custom PC Builds. For details about interpreting product specifications, consult Product Specifications.

title: Custom PC Builds
description: Information about custom gaming PC configurations, assembly, testing, upgrades, delivery times, and warranty conditions.
content:
# Custom PC Builds

PixelForge offers gaming computers designed for different performance requirements, budgets, and gaming preferences. Customers may purchase standard prebuilt systems or request configuration changes when supported by the available product options.

A custom gaming PC allows customers to prioritize components such as the processor, graphics card, memory, storage, and cooling system according to their intended use.

## Choosing a Configuration

When selecting a gaming PC, customers should consider the games and applications they intend to use, their monitor resolution, desired performance, and available budget.

For gaming at 1080p resolution, a balanced mid-range configuration may provide suitable performance for many modern games. Higher resolutions, demanding graphical settings, and high-refresh-rate gaming may benefit from more powerful graphics hardware.

Customers who also perform video editing, software development, streaming, or 3D rendering may require additional processor performance, memory capacity, or storage space.

PixelForge recommends selecting components based on realistic performance requirements rather than purchasing the most expensive available hardware without considering the complete system.

## Available Customization Options

Depending on the computer model, customers may be able to choose between different processors, graphics cards, memory configurations, storage capacities, and cooling solutions.

Not every component combination is available. Certain upgrades may require a different motherboard, power supply, or computer case.

PixelForge reviews supported configurations to reduce the risk of incompatible hardware combinations. However, customers requesting changes outside the available configuration options should contact support before placing an order.

## Assembly and Cable Management

Gaming PCs assembled by PixelForge are built using components selected for the approved configuration.

During assembly, technicians install the processor, memory, storage devices, graphics card, cooling equipment, and other necessary hardware.

Internal cables are arranged to support airflow and reduce interference with moving components such as cooling fans.

Technicians also verify that major power connectors are properly installed and that components are securely mounted.

## Quality Control and Testing

Before dispatch, assembled gaming PCs undergo a quality control procedure. This may include checking that the computer starts correctly, verifying installed hardware, inspecting cooling operation, and performing basic system stability tests.

Where an operating system is included, technicians may verify that the system can complete initial startup and recognize the installed hardware.

Testing is intended to identify obvious assembly or component problems before shipping. It does not guarantee that every possible software configuration or third-party application will operate without issues.

## Operating Systems and Software

Some PixelForge gaming PCs include a preinstalled operating system, while others may be sold without one. The product description identifies what is included.

Customers purchasing a computer without an operating system are responsible for installing suitable software and obtaining any required licenses.

Optional software, additional applications, and third-party subscriptions are not included unless explicitly stated in the product description.

## Assembly and Delivery Times

Standard prebuilt gaming PCs normally have an estimated total delivery time of 5–8 business days after payment confirmation. This includes preparation, testing, dispatch, and transportation.

Custom configurations may require additional assembly time, particularly when selected components are not immediately available.

If a configuration requires special ordering or additional preparation, PixelForge will communicate an estimated timeframe when possible.

Customers receive a shipping confirmation and tracking information once the computer has been dispatched.

For general delivery estimates, see Delivery Times.

## Upgrading a PixelForge Gaming PC

Customers may upgrade compatible components after purchasing a gaming PC. Common upgrades include adding memory, installing additional storage, or replacing the graphics card.

Before upgrading, customers should verify motherboard compatibility, power supply capacity, physical clearance, and cooling requirements.

Incorrect installation or incompatible components may cause system instability or hardware damage.

Customers should disconnect the computer from electrical power before performing internal hardware changes and follow appropriate safety precautions.

## Warranty and Customer Modifications

Standard prebuilt gaming PCs assembled by PixelForge include a voluntary two-year hardware warranty unless otherwise stated at purchase.

The warranty generally covers manufacturing and assembly defects under normal operating conditions. Damage caused by incorrect installation, unsuitable modifications, or misuse may fall outside the voluntary warranty.

Opening the computer case or installing an upgrade does not automatically remove statutory consumer rights. The cause of any reported defect must be assessed in relation to the circumstances.

For complete warranty conditions, see Warranty Policy.

## Returns and Special Configurations

Standard prebuilt gaming PCs are generally covered by ordinary consumer withdrawal rights for online purchases.

Certain clearly personalized or specially manufactured configurations may be subject to legal exceptions when the applicable requirements are satisfied.

Customers should not assume that every assembled computer is automatically excluded from withdrawal rights. The applicable rules depend on the nature of the specific purchase.

For more information, see Return Policy.

## Getting Help With a Build

Customers seeking configuration advice should describe their intended applications, monitor resolution, budget, and any existing hardware they plan to reuse.

Providing this information helps PixelForge identify suitable component combinations and explain potential limitations.

For individual component requirements, consult PC Components Compatibility.

title: Product Specifications
description: How to understand hardware specifications, compare gaming products, and interpret performance information.
content:
# Product Specifications

Product specifications describe the technical characteristics, capabilities, and limitations of hardware sold by PixelForge. Understanding these specifications helps customers compare products and select components that meet their requirements.

Specifications are provided using information supplied by manufacturers and may include details about performance, dimensions, compatibility, power requirements, and supported technologies.

## Understanding Processor Specifications

Processors are commonly described using their model name, architecture, core count, thread count, clock frequencies, cache capacity, and supported memory standards.

Core count indicates the number of physical processing cores available. Thread count describes the number of execution threads exposed by the processor, which may differ from the number of physical cores.

Clock frequency is usually measured in gigahertz. Higher clock frequencies can improve performance in certain workloads, but they should not be used as the only measurement when comparing processors from different architectures.

Cache capacity, power limits, and processor architecture can also significantly affect real-world performance.

Customers should verify socket compatibility and motherboard BIOS support before purchasing a processor.

## Understanding Graphics Card Specifications

Graphics cards are commonly compared using their graphics processor, video memory capacity, memory interface, supported technologies, and power requirements.

Video memory, often called VRAM, stores textures, frame buffers, and other graphical data used during rendering.

A graphics card with more VRAM is not automatically faster than one with less memory. Overall performance depends on the graphics processor, memory bandwidth, architecture, and software optimization.

Customers should also check the card's physical dimensions, cooling design, and required power connectors.

Performance results may vary significantly depending on the game, resolution, graphical settings, and processor used in the test system.

## Monitor Specifications

Gaming monitors are commonly described by their screen size, resolution, refresh rate, response time, panel technology, and supported connections.

Resolution determines the number of pixels displayed. Common gaming resolutions include 1920 × 1080, 2560 × 1440, and 3840 × 2160.

Refresh rate is measured in hertz and describes how many times the display can update its image each second. A 144 Hz monitor can refresh up to 144 times per second, provided the computer and connection can supply the required signal.

Response time describes how quickly pixels change between states, but measurement methods vary between manufacturers. Advertised response times should therefore be interpreted carefully.

Adaptive synchronization technologies may help reduce visible tearing and stuttering when the monitor and graphics hardware support compatible features.

## Memory Specifications

Computer memory is commonly described by its capacity, generation, transfer rate, latency, and module configuration.

For example, a 32 GB DDR5 memory kit may contain two 16 GB modules intended for installation in compatible motherboard slots.

Advertised memory speeds may require enabling XMP or EXPO settings. The actual supported speed depends on the processor, motherboard, firmware, and memory configuration.

Customers should confirm that the motherboard supports the memory generation and desired capacity before purchasing.

## Storage Specifications

Solid-state drives are commonly described by their storage capacity, interface, form factor, and sequential read and write speeds.

SATA SSDs and NVMe SSDs use different communication technologies. NVMe drives connected through PCI Express can offer substantially higher transfer rates than traditional SATA SSDs.

Sequential transfer speeds describe performance when reading or writing large continuous files. Everyday responsiveness also depends on random access performance, workload characteristics, and system configuration.

A faster advertised sequential speed does not guarantee an equally large improvement in game loading times or ordinary application use.

Customers should verify the supported storage interface and physical dimensions before purchasing a drive.

## Keyboard and Mouse Specifications

Gaming keyboards may use mechanical, optical, or membrane-based switches. Switch characteristics influence key feel, activation behavior, and typing experience.

Keyboard specifications may also describe layout, connectivity, polling rate, lighting, and programmable features.

Gaming mice are commonly described by their sensor, sensitivity range, polling rate, weight, and connection method.

Sensitivity is often expressed in DPI or CPI. Higher maximum sensitivity does not automatically indicate better tracking accuracy or overall mouse quality.

Customers should consider ergonomics, intended use, and personal preferences alongside technical specifications.

## Headset Specifications

Gaming headset specifications may include driver size, frequency response, microphone characteristics, connection type, and supported audio features.

A wider advertised frequency range does not automatically guarantee better sound quality. Acoustic design, tuning, microphone processing, and user preferences all influence the listening experience.

Wireless headsets may use Bluetooth or dedicated wireless receivers. Compatibility and latency can vary depending on the connection technology and device.

## Product Images and Descriptions

Product images are intended to illustrate the appearance and general design of an item. Manufacturers may provide promotional images showing optional accessories or configurations that are not included in the standard package.

Customers should rely on the written product description and included accessories list to determine what is supplied.

If an important specification is unclear, customers should contact PixelForge support before placing an order.

## Comparing Products

When comparing hardware, customers should consider the intended application, compatibility requirements, performance measurements, power consumption, and overall cost.

Manufacturer specifications provide useful technical information, but real-world performance may differ depending on software, system configuration, environmental conditions, and usage patterns.

Independent testing can provide additional context, particularly when comparing products with similar specifications.

For compatibility questions, see PC Components Compatibility. For complete gaming PC configurations and assembly procedures, consult Custom PC Builds.

title: Payment Methods
description: Learn about available payment methods, payment confirmation, instalment options, and how payments are handled at PixelForge.
content:
# Payment Methods

PixelForge offers several payment options to make purchasing gaming computers, components, and accessories convenient and secure. The payment methods available for a particular order are displayed during checkout and may depend on the order value, customer eligibility, and payment provider requirements.

All prices displayed in the PixelForge online store are stated in Swedish kronor (SEK) and include applicable Swedish VAT unless otherwise indicated.

## Available Payment Methods

PixelForge supports payments using Visa and Mastercard debit or credit cards. Customers may also be offered payment through Swish, invoice, or instalment plans when these services are available through our payment partners.

Not every payment method is necessarily available for every purchase. For example, invoice and instalment options may require additional eligibility checks by the payment provider.

The available payment methods and any associated fees are displayed before the customer confirms the purchase.

## Card Payments

Customers paying by card must provide the payment information requested by the payment provider. Card transactions may require additional verification through 3D Secure or another authentication procedure.
